# DAX statistical functions in Lumen

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

Support status, in Lumen's DAX engine, of every function that Microsoft's DAX reference lists under **Statistical functions**: 21 implemented, 0 partial and 23 not implemented, out of 44.

The probability distribution functions (NORM.DIST, T.DIST, …) and LINEST / LINESTX are not implemented.
